title: Client Zero edit map
description: The file generated/edit-map.json: for every node type, relation and fact the process and spine definitions use, whether a person edits it and where (DEC-0022). The Platform links a missing or wrong item to its source; it never edits the brain directly, because the loader would undo it.

id.description: A type name, '<From> <relation> <To>' (the edge as stored, from = node_lo) or '<Type>.<fact>'.

editable.description: true: a person changes it at the source; false: it follows from something else.

source.description: File glob or system that owns it.

key_path.description: Where in the source: front-matter field, table row, YAML key.

fix_at.description: For a non-editable item: what to change instead.

format.description: Datatype of a fact (enum, text, date, …), or how a node or edge is written.

allowed_values.description: Enum values of a fact, the key patterns of a type, or the domain and range of a relation; null when free.
